# Elite Dental

> Elite Dental is a general, cosmetic, implant and sedation dental practice in East Tennessee with two offices, Dandridge and Jefferson City. Founded in 2007 by Dr. George F. Johnson III, DMD and Dr. Paul Jason Chaney, DMD. Rated 4.9 stars on Google at both locations. Accepting new patients ages 12 and up.

## Locations

- [Elite Dental Dandridge](https://www.elitedentalsmiles.com/dandridge-dentist): 334 TN-92 #1, Dandridge, TN 37725. Phone (865) 397-5422. Monday to Thursday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Fee-for-service practice; Dr. Winslow is in network with Cigna. 4.9 stars from 628 Google reviews.
- [Elite Dental Jefferson City](https://www.elitedentalsmiles.com/jefferson-city-dentist): 683 E Broadway Blvd, Jefferson City, TN 37760. Phone (865) 475-8331. Monday to Thursday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Dr. Rachel Chaney is in network with Cigna, Delta Dental and BCBS. 4.9 stars from 330 Google reviews.
- Both offices are closed Friday through Sunday.
- Patients come from Dandridge, Jefferson City, Morristown, Newport, White Pine, Talbott, Sevierville and the greater Knoxville area.
- Children under 12 are seen next door to the Dandridge office at Dandridge Pediatric Dentistry.

## Doctors

- Dr. George F. Johnson III, DMD (goes by Dr. Frank Johnson): co-founder. University of Louisville School of Dentistry, 2006. Holds a comprehensive sedation permit from the Tennessee Board of Dentistry, performs IV sedation, and holds Nobel Biocare implant surgery certification. Focus: sedation, cosmetic and implant dentistry.
- Dr. Paul Jason Chaney, DMD (goes by Dr. Jason Chaney): co-founder. University of Louisville, 2006. Focus: cosmetic and implant dentistry. Sees patients at both offices.
- Dr. Rachel N. Chaney, DMD: University of Louisville, 2016. Practices at Jefferson City. Experience in endodontics, oral surgery, full mouth rehabilitation and cosmetic dentistry.
- Dr. John Winslow, DMD: East Carolina University, residency at the University of Tennessee with advanced training in implants and surgery. Practices at Dandridge.

## Services

- [Sedation dentistry](https://www.elitedentalsmiles.com/sedation-dentistry): nitrous oxide, oral sedation and IV sedation for anxious patients and longer procedures.
- [Dental implants](https://www.elitedentalsmiles.com/dental-implants): placed in house from consultation through final restoration, with no specialist referral needed.
- [All-on-4 full arch implants](https://www.elitedentalsmiles.com/all-on-4)
- [Porcelain veneers](https://www.elitedentalsmiles.com/veneers)
- [Cosmetic dentistry](https://www.elitedentalsmiles.com/cosmetic-dentistry)
- [Teeth whitening](https://www.elitedentalsmiles.com/teeth-whitening)
- [Crowns and bridges](https://www.elitedentalsmiles.com/crowns-bridges)
- [Root canal therapy](https://www.elitedentalsmiles.com/root-canal)
- [Emergency dentistry](https://www.elitedentalsmiles.com/emergency-dentistry): call during business hours for urgent guidance and triage.
- Family dentistry, cleanings and exams at both offices.

## Paying for care

- In-house membership plan for patients without insurance: [Elite Dental Membership](https://www.elitedentalsmiles.com/membership). Adult $39/month, Perio $63/month, one-time $149 activation fee. Includes 2 cleanings (Perio: 3 to 4 periodontal maintenance cleanings), 1 to 2 exams, necessary x-rays, 1 emergency exam a year and 15% off eligible treatment. The routine visit on the day a patient joins is included. Not insurance. Available at both offices.
- Financing options are available.
